questions_and_answers.question_text: Listen to the instructor's statement and respond appropriately (in Japanese): 千円のと千二百円のがございます。 (Sen-en no to sen-nihyaku-en no ga gozaimasu.)

answers.answer_text: 千円のをください。 (Sen-en no o kudasai.) — I'll take the one that is 1,000 yen.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Listen to the instructor's statement and respond appropriately (in Japanese): 大きいのはありますが、小さいのはありません。 (Ookii no wa arimasu ga, chiisai no wa arimasen.)

answers.answer_text: じゃあ、大きいのをください。 (Jaa, ookii no o kudasai.) — Then I'll take the large one. (OR: Jaa, kekkoo desu. Mata kimasu.)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Listen to the instructor's statement and respond appropriately (in Japanese): あいにくですが、これだけです。 (Ainiku desu ga, kore dake desu.)

answers.answer_text: じゃあ、結構です。また来ます。 (Jaa, kekkoo desu. Mata kimasu.) — Then, that's OK. I'll come again.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Listen to the instructor's statement and respond appropriately (in Japanese): LLサイズはありますが、LとMはありません。 (LL saizu wa arimasu ga, L to M wa arimasen.)

answers.answer_text: じゃあ、LLサイズのをください。 (Jaa, LL saizu no o kudasai.) — Then I'll take the LL size. (OR: Jaa, kekkoo desu. Mata kimasu.)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Listen to the instructor's statement and respond appropriately (in Japanese): あいにくですが、ちがう形のはございません。 (Ainiku desu ga, chigau katachi no wa gozaimasen.)

answers.answer_text: じゃあ、結構です。また来ます。 (Jaa, kekkoo desu. Mata kimasu.) — Then, that's OK. I'll come again.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Listen to the instructor's statement and respond appropriately (in Japanese): 一つ三百円ですが、四つ千円です。 (Hitotsu sanbyaku-en desu ga, yottsu sen-en desu.)

answers.answer_text: じゃあ、四つください。 (Jaa, yottsu kudasai.) — Then give me four.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Listen to the instructor's statement and respond appropriately (in Japanese): ちがう色は、赤と青だけです。 (Chigau iro wa, aka to ao dake desu.)

answers.answer_text: じゃあ、赤いのをください。 (Jaa, akai no o kudasai.) — Then I'll take the red one.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Listen to the instructor's statement and respond appropriately (in Japanese): 百グラム二百円と三百円です。 (Hyaku-guramu nihyaku-en to sanbyaku-en desu.)

answers.answer_text: じゃあ、二百円のを三百グラムください。 (Jaa, nihyaku-en no o sanbyaku-guramu kudasai.) — Then give me 300 grams of the one that is 200 yen.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Listen to the instructor's statement and respond appropriately (in Japanese): お客様、あいにくですが、ちょっと… (Okyakusama, ainiku desu ga, chotto...)

answers.answer_text: そうですか。じゃあ、結構です。また来ます。 (Soo desu ka. Jaa, kekkoo desu. Mata kimasu.) — I see. Then, that's OK. I'll come again.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Listen to the instructor's statement and respond appropriately (in Japanese): こちらは百グラム二百円、こちらは三百円です。 (Kochira wa hyaku-guramu nihyaku-en, kochira wa sanbyaku-en desu.)

answers.answer_text: じゃあ、二百円のを五百グラムください。 (Jaa, nihyaku-en no o gohyaku-guramu kudasai.) — Then give me 500 grams of the one that is 200 yen.
